title: Trace spin source and photon prescription must close before a duality signal

source_evidence.locator: Eqs.(2),(7),(11)-(12),(41)-(51); Appendix A preamble/Eqs.(A1)-(A3), Appendix B

assumptions: Source Frenkel condition and Cartan equation are imposed as printed; no new spin current is invented.
Electromagnetism uses connection-independent gauge-invariant F=dA; opacity/nonminimal photon coupling has not been supplied.
Formal eta expansion retains both Phi-sign branches; |Phi/H|<1 is not a quantified truncation-error guarantee.
predictions: Cartan trace contraction gives −2 S_lambda=kappa s_lambda_nu u^nu=0, while the homogeneous trace ansatz gives S_lambda=−3Phi u_lambda/2. Nonzero Phi requires changing or completing the source.

Minimal Maxwell equations imply Levi-Civita stress conservation/geometric optics; the assumed full-connection conservation in Eq.(44) needs conversion terms. Nonzero eta is not established by the stated photon sector.
The author formal integral has signed eta≈±(2/3)sqrt(1−d²)[asin(xi(1+z)^(3/2))−asin(xi)], xi=sqrt(Delta/Omega_m0); its algebra does not certify a physical duality violation.
